blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Three sewing workers were found dead inside the warehouse where they were staying in Barangay Campetic, Palo, Leyte, early Wednesday, with authorities investigating whether a generator operating inside the poorly ventilated building caused their deaths. The victims—two men and a woman—were found lifeless inside the sewing workshop in Zone 6 of the barangay on Sept. 16. Police are investigating whether the generator produced carbon monoxide that accumulated inside the enclosed area, potentially causing carbon monoxide poisoning.
